Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft Teams is expanding presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see for Teams events. Event organizers and producers can now drag and resize the presenter panel, allowing them to view more presenters simultaneously during event production.

This improvement helps producers more easily monitor available presenters, streamline presenter transitions, and manage large events with greater efficiency.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 567467.

Rollout schedule

  • Targeted Release: Beginning mid-August 2026 and expected to complete by late August 2026
  • General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning late August 2026 and expected to complete by early September 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Teams event organizers
  • Teams event producers
  • Users who manage live event production experiences in Microsoft Teams

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Teams events

What will happen

  • Users will be able to drag and resize the presenter panel in Manage what attendees see.
  • The larger presenter panel can display more presenters at one time.
  • Users can view more presenters at once, reducing the need to switch between pages when managing large events.
  • Producers will have improved visibility into presenter availability during events.
  • Presenter transitions can be managed more efficiently, particularly during large events with many presenters.
  • This change is enabled automatically and does not require configuration.

Action required and recommendations

No admin action is required.

You may want to:

  • Inform event organizers and producers about the updated presenter management experience.
  • Update internal training materials and event production guidance, if applicable.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
